trust_decision.summary: Client-side TagSuggest widget (var/www/static/js/tags.js) decides whether a tag's display string from server JSON is inserted as HTML or text; at the pinned commit it always inserts as HTML (suggestion list and selection chips), and setValue eval()s string values. No server-side escaping of tag names exists.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'Tag Selector via unescaped tag names'; the selector widget is tags.js and the suggestion item is built with jQuery `html:` from value[cfg.displayField].

fix_sites.entry_point: Any page embedding the tag selector (e.g. var/www/templates/tags/block_tags_selector.html:65-70 fed by GET /tag/get_taxonomies_customs_tags, var/www/blueprints/tags_ui.py:230-234); suggestion dropdown _renderComboItems
fix_sites.module_kind: vendored third-party JS widget (MagicSuggest fork), client-side

fix_sites.entry_point: Same widget; selection chips _renderSelection (pre-selected values from template tojson, or items picked from suggestions)
Public widget API setValue(string) / cfg.value at render (var/www/static/js/tags.js:959-960); eval replaced by JSON.parse
fix_sites.module_kind: vendored third-party JS widget, client-side public API

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All changed sites are in var/www/static/js/tags.js (fix.diff:45-117); the other commit (fix.diff:1-39, bin/lib/objects/ail_objects.py is_filtered) is an unrelated merge, not part of the protection.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The eval in setValue (var/www/static/js/tags.js:656) is unreachable from the project's own templates, which pass arrays via tojson (var/www/templates/tags/block_tags_selector.html:55-67), so a solver can argue it is not a tag-name sink.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Custom renderer/selectionRenderer callbacks are documented to return HTML and keep HTML insertion after the fix; query highlighting (<em>) in _highlightSuggestion only applies on the renderer path. An over-broad fix that text-escapes everything breaks the renderer API; galaxy names include synonyms joined by ', ' and must still display.

O6_input_shapes: array of strings (taxonomy/custom tags) converted to {name,id} by _getEntriesFromStringArray (var/www/static/js/tags.js:742-750, 850-852)
array of {name,id} objects (galaxy tags with synonyms, bin/lib/Tag.py:1150-1157)
pre-selected value list (template tojson) rendered through _renderSelection (var/www/static/js/tags.js:959-961)
string value containing '[' passed to setValue (eval -> JSON.parse, var/www/static/js/tags.js:654-656)
resultAsString text mode vs chip mode in _renderSelection (var/www/static/js/tags.js:1017-1027)

O7_producer.where: bin/lib/Tag.py:1202-1205 (create_custom_tag stores names unvalidated, reached from bin/lib/Tracker.py:414-417); served by var/www/blueprints/tags_ui.py:259-263

O8b_injection_room.sibling: group header built with `html: grpName` from value[cfg.groupBy]; enable groupBy (e.g. by taxonomy namespace) in a caller so tag-derived group names reach it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: groupBy is a documented widget option (var/www/static/js/tags.js:133); grouping tags by taxonomy/galaxy is a natural UI feature and the header path was left untouched by the fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: _updateHelper uses .html(); a caller could set noSuggestionText or maxSelectionRenderer echoing the typed query or last tag
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Showing 'No tag matching <query>' is a common UX tweak; the helper is HTML by design.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second selector implementation (e.g. a lightweight custom-tag dropdown in another template building buttons by string concatenation) at distance from tags.js
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Templates already build taxonomy dropdown buttons next to the widget; a JS-built variant for custom tags would plausibly use string concatenation.

O9_family: XSS (DOM sink: jQuery html insertion of stored tag names) plus eval of string input (CWE-79/CWE-94)

O10_build.language: JavaScript (client widget) in a Python/Flask application
O10_build.toolchain: Python 3 + Flask for the app; affected code is a jQuery plugin testable in a headless DOM (jsdom + jQuery) without the backend
O10_build.project_tests: None for this area: tests/ holds only Python module/API tests (tests/test_api.py, tests/test_modules.py); no JS tests or package.json.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace `html:` with `text:` in _renderComboItems only (the reproduced dropdown), leaving selection chips and the setValue eval open, or escape server-side in get_tag_selector_dict only (misses the string-array endpoints).
